description.value: The Taphouse is a modern neighborhood pub in Surrey's Guildford area, part of the Taphouse Modern Taverns brand that also operates in Coquitlam. The original location features a full food menu spanning appetizers to desserts, a craft beer and cocktail program, and a large sports-viewing setup reported at 48 flat-screen TVs. It is a 19+ venue with live music nights and operates as a community gathering spot.
